title: Browser cat household simulation
decision: Direct a household of cats with personalities and free will.

title: All play pillars
decision: Personalities/drama, building/decorating, and care/goals/progression are all core.

title: Cat antics and whimsical lives
decision: Real feline behavior alongside hobbies, adventures, goals, careers, and romance.

title: Phone and computer parity
decision: Phone and computer are equally important; core actions work on both.

title: Approved art
decision: Use the approved A + B image: pastel cartoon cats and furnishings, overhead cutaway home, pixel-detailed neighborhood.

title: Full house building
decision: Build rooms, walls, doors and decorate with furniture, colors and cat furnishings.

title: Real and fictional cats
decision: Recreate real cats and create or adopt fictional cats, with names, looks and personalities.

title: Death and permanent loss
decision: Death and permanent loss are explicitly in scope; do not restore the superseded no-death boundary.

title: Pause when closed
decision: No simulation time, aging, needs decay or death while the game is closed.

title: Automatic synced saves
decision: Continue the same household automatically between computer and phone.

title: Private gift
decision: Game access is for her and testing; public source does not authorize public gameplay registration.

title: Money and unlocks
decision: Earn game money and unlock content in normal play.

title: Optional free-build
decision: Offer optional free-build alongside earned progression.

title: Careers
decision: Scheduled careers with skills and promotions.

title: Hobbies and businesses
decision: Hobbies and little businesses are also income sources.

title: Moo-Moo terminology
decision: Call the action exactly Moo-Moo.

title: Mutual readiness
decision: Cats must be in love, aligned, and in the mood; player input cannot override the other cat.

title: Autonomous and directed
decision: Moo-Moo can be initiated by cats or suggested by the player.

title: Chance of kittens
decision: Moo-Moo carries a chance of kittens, not a guaranteed pregnancy.

title: Eight-cat capacity
decision: Maximum eight living household cats, including kittens.

title: Moo-Moo at capacity
decision: At eight cats, Moo-Moo remains available but cannot initiate a new pregnancy.

title: Memorial and ghosts
decision: Death creates a memorial; occasional ghost visits do not resurrect the cat.

title: Fixed lifespan
decision: Pace between normal and slow; no adjustable lifespan setting.

title: One neighborhood
decision: One lively playable neighborhood with homes, café, park, shops and other cats.

title: Included picture
decision: Include the exact approved image in the model handoff and repository.
